part.text:
All 1936 symbol-solver tests pass (0 failures/errors), and both method calls from the issue now resolve.

Fix: added a `visit(TextBlockLiteralExpr)` override in `TypeExtractor` (javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/TypeExtractor.java:296) that returns `stringReferenceType`, since a text block literal is just a `String`. Previously it fell through to `DefaultVisitorAdapter`'s `UnsupportedOperationException`, causing the `UnsolvedSymbolException`.
